description: On the table are several colorful plastic cups, with a green cup being handled near a yellow cup in the foreground and other cups and a yellow bottle in the background. The left hand steadies and tilts the green cup while the right hand pulls a blue textured scrubber/toothbrush out of it, then brings the scrubber back to the cup’s opening and rubs it along the rim and inside; the green cup and blue scrubber alternate between being a two-hand object when pressed together and separate left-hand object (cup) and right-hand object (scrubber) when apart.
